digest.component_or_area: reconciler coordinator outcome serialization and state advancement
propositions: Versioned lifecycle, retry, and fuse outcome sections must be rendered with exact pass tallies and cursor behavior while preserving existing mutation fields and canonical hash.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain ineligible for advancement and eligible for re-observation in later passes.

The repair_at_write_boundary call must be positioned after staleness validation (ensure_selection_current) and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent race conditions between durable tombstones and fresh observations.
Applied and recovered mutation counts must be disjoint and exact: mutations_applied must exclude recovered outcomes, and all tally buckets must be non-overlapping and sum to the total mutation count.
All manifest output must redact secrets and bound every diagnostic field and collection without exceeding size limits.
Extraction of reconcile.py phases must preserve the call-graph seam structure and keep the file under the 800-line cap without raising the limit.
